text:
nina: Quick announcement  Global Hub Exchange week is open for signups (May 12-16). This is a cross-team in-person week where people can request microgrants for travel/hotel. TL;DR: signup form, eligibility, whats covered below.

oscar: Awesome. Who's eligible? Remote folks only or any Redwooder?

nina: All employees can apply, priority to cross-team contributors and early-career folks. Full eligibility details on the form.

mai: Microgrant amounts? Flights + hotel?

nina: Microgrants cover up to $600 for domestic travel, $1,200 for international. We can also top up for visa or unexpected quarantine costs case-by-case. Hotel blocks available in SF, PDX, and LON.

ops-bot: calendar-update: Hub Exchange blocks added to SF/PDX/LON office calendars.

oscar: Visa letter / invitation needed for international travel?

travel-team: If you need an employer letter for visa, fill the 'visa support' checkbox on the form and travel-team will issue a signed letter within 3 business days. Include passport name and intended dates.

mai: Are we booking travel or do we reimburse?

nina: For speed we reimburse. Book flights under flexible fares if possible and keep receipts. Submit to Expensify with tag "hub-exchange-2026". We'll reimburse up to the grant cap. If you want travel-team to assist with booking, add the 'assist' option on the form.

oscar: Any hotel rules / roommate matching?

nina: Hotels are individual rooms. We have a limited number of subsidized rooms at partner hotels; selection is first-come, then priority list. If you want to buddy up to save cost, DM Travel and we'll try to coordinate.

harper: What about COVID/quarantine policies if countries require tests?

travel-team: Travel policy: if official guidance requires testing/quarantine, keep receipts and tag "hub-exchange-2026"; we'll review for additional support. If your country requires a 5+ day quarantine, we may offer a partial remote-work stipend — discuss with People Ops.

mai: Childcare or caregiver help while traveling?

nina: We offer a small travel caregiver stipend (up to $120/day, max 2 days) to offset childcare while you're onsite. Submit receipts to Expensify, tag "hub-exchange-care". Manager approval required for extended remote coverage.

oscar: If I cancel last-minute due to illness, can I keep the grant?

travel-team: If you cancel >72 hours before departure, no problem. If you cancel <72 hours for medical reasons with proof, we can still reimburse non-refundable costs. Otherwise funds are reallocated.

harper: Where's the signup form?

nina: Form: https://tiny.redwood/hub-exchange-signup. Please complete by Apr 18. We'll email approvals and hotel codes by Apr 25.

oscar: Any team lead approvals required?

nina: Please notify your manager on the form; they don't need to pre-approve the grant but must approve time away per usual.

mai: Thanks! Excited to meet folks in person.

nina: We'll post an FAQ doc and the priority rubric tomorrow. Ping People Ops or Travel for special cases.
